sut.text:
That sounds like a genuinely frustrating way to have your event disrupted, and I'm sorry your guests had to deal with that.

I don't have the authority to determine liability or compensation for what happened — that's not something I can resolve here. Let me get our events manager to look into this and follow up with you today. Can you share the event date and the name it was booked under so they have what they need?
